description:

India’s youth is trapped in a vicious cycle of lifestyle choices, government negligence, and rising health crises. This video uncovers the harsh reality of blood cancer in India – a disease that is silently destroying lives while the system looks the other way.

🚬 Cigarettes & Tobacco: Despite endless campaigns, tobacco consumption among the youth remains dangerously high. Smoking is directly linked to multiple cancers, including blood cancer, yet availability is everywhere.

🍺 Alcohol Addiction: Easy access to cheap alcohol has normalized drinking culture among students and young professionals. What begins as casual consumption often leads to long-term health damage, weakening immunity and increasing cancer risks.

⚠️ Junk Food & Lifestyle: Processed food, lack of exercise, and polluted environments are fueling a health crisis that nobody wants to talk about.

🏛️ Government Negligence: Instead of strict regulation and awareness programs, policies remain half-hearted. The tobacco and alcohol lobbies continue to thrive while the youth pay the price with their lives.

🧬 The Reality of Blood Cancer: Every year, thousands of young Indians are diagnosed with blood cancers like leukemia, lymphoma, and myeloma. Most cases are detected late because awareness is minimal and healthcare remains inaccessible to millions.
